name: Congressman Jim Jordan
subject: Save the date — I'll be in NC-14
body:
Peter,I don't get to North Carolina as often as I'd like -- but when Tim Moore asked me to come stand with him in Gaston County, there was no way I was saying no.Tim and I serve together in the House, and I've seen firsthand how hard he fights for hardworking families in western North Carolina. He doesn't grandstand. He doesn't chase headlines. He just shows up and gets the job done -- on fiscal responsibility, on cutting red tape, on standing firm against the kind of reckless spending that's bankrupting this country.That's why I'm asking you to join us: [](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fatudk-hkhielhuy-r/) **An Evening with Congressman Jim Jordan & Congressman Tim Moore**
Friday, July 31st | 5:00 PM
Gaston Country Club
3700 County Club Drive
Gastonia, NC [CLICK HERE TO RSVP AND MAKE YOUR DONATION NOW](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fatudk-hkhielhuy-y/) This is a grassroots event -- and I hope you'll stand with us to hold the line for NC-14. I want a room full of people who know what's at stake this November and are ready to help Tim keep representing our values the right way.**Reserve your spot today** by replying to this email, or contacting Tara Mingledorff at [**RSVP@CastlebarStrategies.com**](mailto:RSVP@CastlebarStrategies.com).I hope to see you there.In the fight, Rep. Jim Jordan (OH-04)_If you're unable to attend but would still like to support Congressman Moore's efforts, contributions may be mailed to:**Moore Victory Committee, PO Box 97275, Raleigh, NC 27624**_ Paid for by Moore Victory Committee, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and composed of Friends of Tim Moore, NC2DC Leadership PAC, and NRCC.
PO Box 97275 Raleigh, NC 27624. | [Unsubscribe](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-u-fatudk-hkhielhuy-t/)
---

A deep dive into Colorado's dirty voter roll
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**July 13, 2026** **MONDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,
Over the past several weeks, we've published one of the most extensive investigations Rocky Mountain Voice has ever undertaken.
Using Colorado's publicly available voter roll, state statutes, election records and other publicly available data, guest columnist Mike O'Donnell has spent months examining one fundamental question: **_**How accurate is Colorado's voter roll, and are there vulnerabilities that deserve closer scrutiny?**_**
The investigation has followed the _**entire life cycle of a ballot.**_
It began by examining how voters are added to Colorado's rolls through [automatic registration](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) before exploring whether [outdated registrations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) are removed as efficiently as they're added. From there, the series looked at [Colorado's participation in ERIC](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), ballots mailed to []()out-of-state and international addresses, [chain-of-custody procedures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after ballots leave the Postal Service, and examples the author says appear to show [duplicate voter registrations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) created through differences in identifying information.
This week's sixth installment goes a step further, examining Colorado's citizenship verification process, why the author believes outside review of voter eligibility is limited, and an [unusual pattern uncovered at a single Aurora apartment](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) where 104 voter registrants became associated with what appears to be a one-bedroom unit over a two-year period. O'Donnell notes that none of those registrants currently have active status, that only one of the 104 ever cast a ballot according to voter history records, and argues the case illustrates why stronger front-end safeguards and address verification may be needed.
Throughout the series, we've encouraged readers to do what good journalism asks of all of us: _**examine the evidence, read the source material, and think critically.**_ Whether you agree with every conclusion or not, transparency builds trust—and trust in our elections depends on a willingness to ask difficult questions and openly examine the systems that underpin them.
This week, the seventh and final installment will conclude the investigation, bringing together the author's findings and recommendations after months of reviewing Colorado's voter registration system.
_**Catch up on the entire series so far below:**_
1️⃣ [Getting on is the easy part](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) 2️⃣ [Getting off isn’t so easy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
3️⃣ [Where the ballots go](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
4️⃣ [Following the ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
5️⃣ [When one registration becomes two](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) 6️⃣ [The curious case of Apartment A503](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Whether this series reinforces your existing views or challenges them, we believe it's worth reading in full. An informed citizenry is the foundation of self-government.
Thank you for reading, asking questions, and staying engaged.
In truth & liberty,
Team RMV

**[No way out: Rural Colorado is outvoted at every turn](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Tom Harrington manages a 500-cow operation on the Crystal River Ranch, two miles from the town of Carbondale on a mesa west of town. He grew up in Ridgway. A friend sent him some papers from the North Park area of Walden showing the school news, a note from the old folks’ home and local ads.
**[Colorado’s dirty voter roll: Where the ballots go](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MIKE O'DONNELL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Getting on and getting off the voter rolls were the first two questions. In Part 3, Mike O’Donnell turns to where Colorado voter data and ballots go next—through ERIC, out-of-state mailing addresses and overseas voting rules he argues deserve closer scrutiny.
**[Colorado’s dirty voter roll: Following the ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MIKE O'DONNELL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado relies on the U.S. Postal Service to deliver millions of ballots, but the mail carrier isn't always the last person to handle them. In Part 4, Mike O'Donnell examines Colorado's chain of custody—from group homes and shelters to commercial mail locations, drop boxes and ballot harvesting.
|
---
**STATE**
**[Pickens Technical College signed a disability agreement. Then dismissed the student.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Some mornings, she didn’t know how she got to where she was. A Colorado Springs woman who asked to remain anonymous — referred to here as CSW — had been an EMT for more than a decade, a career she began while volunteering with a fire department. She shared dozens of emails documenting her case with RMV.
**[Children’s Hospital Colorado insurance data tells one story—its testimony another.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KELLY NOTARFRANCESCO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Hundreds of children were provided puberty blockers or cross-sex hormones by Children’s Hospital Colorado’s TRUE Center for Gender Diversity annually in 2024 and 2025 — in numbers that may be more than 35 times higher than those previously reported in 2024 by medical watchdog group Do No Harm.
__
**[Colorado immediately assessed Trump’s election order. USPS defended its proposal. A court blocked key parts.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado election officials said they diverted staff to evaluate President Trump's executive order while 2026 preparations were already underway. USPS said the proposal formalizes election-mail practices it has recommended for years. The dispute has now moved to the appeals courts.

**LOCAL**
**[Federal lawsuit says Denver school board used race to draw voting districts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A conservative election-law firm filed a federal lawsuit against the Denver Public Schools Board of Education on July 2, arguing the board deliberately drew its school district voting map along racial lines. The board’s own words, the suit says, prove it.
__
**[Colorado College Awards Credit for Progressive Activism Internships](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado College is putting a price tag on political activism — or rather, waiving it for its own students — by offering academic credit to undergraduates who spend the summer, among other offerings, working to “shut down immigration detention centers.”

**[Why capitalism and the Constitution still offer America’s best path](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY RUSS MINARY, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _“From each according to his abilities, to each according to his needs.” – Karl Marx. Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels published “The Communist Manifesto” in 1848. The popular quote above appeared in Marx’s “Critique of the Gotha Programme” written 1875. This article will examine how that idealistic worldview has – or has not – worked out in reality. Spoiler alert: it hasn’t._
____
**[Should America reserve its highest offices for natural-born citizens?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY CHRISTINE COLEMAN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _When God brought the children of Israel into the Promised Land, He established clear laws and commandments for their governance. Among them was the explicit requirement that rulers must be chosen from among their own people — no foreigner born outside the nation was permitted to rule over God’s covenant people._
__
**[The American Dream is slipping away and socialism is filling the gap](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[AMERICAN THINKER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Not long ago, the American Dream followed a familiar script. Graduate from school, find a job, buy a modest home, start a family, and gradually build a better life than the generation before you._

**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A week before the 250th anniversary of America declaring independence, more than 1,000 people assembled at the nation’s capital to make a declaration of their own: their vision to dismantle America’s founding institutions. “All of US Next250 National Mobilization” protested the Trump administration, debuted new “founding documents,” and re-envisioned America as seen by Marxist revolutionaries.

" President Trump on [March 31] stepped up efforts to promote his false claims of widespread voting fraud, signing an executive order of questionable constitutionality seeking to create a national list of citizens that would determine voting eligibility and restrict mail ballots. "
Let's be clear: The president has no explicit Constitutional authority over elections, and much of this latest attack on our fundamental right to vote appears difficult to enforce and legally dubious.
This order directs the Department of Homeland Security to create a “ state citizenship list ” based on data from various federal databases. It also directs federal officials to send that made-up list to state election officials, and orders the attorney general to prioritize prosecution of election officials who provide ballots to voters not on the made-up list. It also directs the U.S. Postal Service not to transmit mail-in ballots from any individual not included on Trump's “ state citizenship list ," even though elections are mandated by the constitutional the be run by the states.
This order is yet another sign that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.

body:
Let’s talk about experience
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260713-3029)
Peter,
I spend a lot of time talking about Wisconsin's future. Today, I'd like to tell you a little more about my past.
Since being elected to the Wisconsin Legislature in 2020, I've authored dozens of bills to make life better for working-class families.
I've led the fight for a moratorium on AI data centers, andI've introduced legislation to lower utility bills, provide healthy school meals for every child, and establish universal paid leave. I’ve also pushed to tax the ultra-wealthy so working families can finally catch a break, and fought to protect Wisconsin from ICE.
One of the things I'm proudest of is working across the aisle with Republicans to successfully pass bipartisan legislation that had to do with diversity, equity, inclusion AND education (can you even imagine?).
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260713.sCLbJC&refcode=em20260713-3029&t=1&akid=3029%2E105371%2EMhjAUp)
Experiences like this remind me that even in today's political climate, it's still possible to find common ground when you stay focused on solving problems instead of scoring political points.
Long before I was elected, I was serving my community in a different way.
As a chef and small business owner, I learned how to lead under pressure, stretch every dollar, and bring people together around a common table. I co-founded two nonprofits to feed neighbors facing food insecurity while supporting restaurant workers through some of the hardest moments our communities have faced.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260713.sCLbJC&refcode=em20260713-3029&t=2&akid=3029%2E105371%2EMhjAUp)
Those experiences shaped the kind of leader I am today.
I've led a kitchen as executive chef, and now I'm running to lead Wisconsin's executive branch. I can handle the heat, I'm ready on day one. As governor, I'll lead the same way I always have, with transparency and constant communication with all the invested parties. I'll uplift the voices of those closest to the problems so we can find the best solutions. I'll find common ground with my colleagues in the legislature.
**[If you believe Wisconsin deserves a governor with a proven record of fighting for working people, I hope you'll help power this campaign today.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260713.sCLbJC&refcode=em20260713-3029&t=3&akid=3029%2E105371%2EMhjAUp)**
**[Please chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can to help us win](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260713.sCLbJC&refcode=em20260713-3029&t=4&akid=3029%2E105371%2EMhjAUp). **
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260713.sCLbJC&refcode=em20260713-3029&t=5&akid=3029%2E105371%2EMhjAUp)
From the bottom of my heart, I want to thank you for being in this fight with us. We make better possible.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260713.sCLbJC&amount=5&refcode=em20260713-3029&t=8&akid=3029%2E105371%2EMhjAUp)**
With gratitude,
Francesca Hong

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: New Mexico Just Got Ranked Dead Last.
body:
Plus: Graham gone at 71, and a two-week scramble for his seat | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/SFEAjQoNV5E?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |

A new study just ranked New Mexico the number one worst state in America to move to, and the categories they graded us on are everything we talk about on this show every week. [And we woke up to surprising news this weekend](https://us.list-manage.com/1BCTYZbgv0v?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e): Lindsey Graham passed away Saturday night at 71. Whatever you thought of him, he was a giant, and we play the one clip from his career that everybody should see.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/I6ISJ6MAJeJ?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🔥 **NEW MEXICO RANKED THE WORST STATE TO MOVE TO. THEN A SECOND LIST MADE IT WORSE.**

The first study grades safety, healthcare, education, the stuff that actually matters. We come in last. Fine. We know we've got problems, and we talk about the fix.
The second list is where Mark lost it. CNBC put out their "worst states to live" rankings, and when he read what they based Tennessee on out loud, Krysty just started laughing. Every state on their list has one thing in common, and it's got nothing to do with jobs, safety, or schools.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/3QslnKh0HD2?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
🇺🇸 **LINDSEY GRAHAM GONE AT 71, AND THE CLIP EVERY STATION SHOULD BE PLAYING**
Lindsey Graham was booked on Meet the Press Sunday morning. He passed away Saturday night at 71. We play the Kavanaugh hearing moment we think was the best of his entire career. If you've never seen it, watch the episode just for that.
Then the politics kick in fast. Anyone who wants his Senate seat has two weeks to file. Two weeks! And there's one name that could blow the whole race open.
🦬 **A BISON LAUNCHES GRANDPA 8 FEET, AND OUR MOUNTAIN LION IS DOING LAPS**
You have to see this Yellowstone video. A bull bison sends a grandfather flying 8 feet, and the poor guy did absolutely nothing wrong. Watch what actually sets it off. Then our trail cams caught our mountain lion again. Twice in two hours. Krysty has officially retired from hiking that trail.
---
| [WATCH NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/P0nK8jqOsjP?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
🏔️ **THE MARK VS. THE MOUNTAIN SEASON FINALE IS THIS THURSDAY**
A year of fighting that mountain comes down to one episode. The reveal drops this Thursday on Amazon Prime Video, and we really love how it turned out.
Need to catch up first? Pure Flix is 99 cents this month. Just search "Mark vs. The Mountain" on Prime Video. Every view helps us grow the show and bring season two home to New Mexico.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/y3mSWX4_0yw?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
|
---
| |

**🎟️ WE'RE EMCEEING THE**[**STATESMAN DINNER JULY 25**](https://us.list-manage.com/OrDqXVb0QPB?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)**\- RSVP NOW**

Come see us in person! We're hosting the Republican Party of New Mexico's biggest night of the year — a black-tie dinner celebrating America's 250th, Saturday, July 25 at Isleta Resort & Casino.
You'll hear from gubernatorial nominee Gregg Hull, plus a keynote from Nick Shirley, the independent journalist whose undercover investigations have been making national news all year. It's going to be a fun night, and we'd love to see you there.
[Grab your tickets here.](https://us.list-manage.com/SoRPhwQQEHE?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
|
---

| | Dear Peter,
Around the country, working people are throwing out incumbent, warmongering Democrats who have backed the genocide in Gaza and carried out a bipartisan assault against our interests. Working people everywhere are fed up with the immense inequality in our society where billionaires parade around in yachts while most of us are struggling to afford basic necessities like housing, medical bills, and groceries.
In Washington State, we have the opportunity to defeat a genocidal, strike-breaking Democrat, Adam Smith, who has been in office for 29 years, and to elect the first ever revolutionary socialist to the US Congress, Kshama Sawant.
Our campaign is fighting to end all US military aid to Israel and to stop all weapons and tech for genocide and imperialist wars. We are fighting to shut down ICE and the detention centers. We are fighting to stop the data centers and AI-related mass layoffs. We are fighting to stop the climate catastrophe by taking big energy corporations into democratic public ownership of workers, so we can make a lightning-fast transition to clean energy and end the use of fossil fuels.
There is massive anger among the working class at Trump's deportation machine and the horrific bloodshed in the Middle East driven by both parties. The AI boom has also left many working people concerned about their jobs, their living conditions, and the sustainability of the planet due to the extreme amounts of energy consumed by data centers and the deregulated fossil fuel industry. All of this is leading us towards a complete disaster of epic proportions.
We urgently need to fight back and Kshama's campaign is the most important spearhead in that fight right now. Kshama has a long track record of leading movements to beat the billionaires, like when she defeated Jeff Bezos to win the Amazon Tax. She also defeated the corporate landlords, including billionaire Trump-donor Martin Selig, to win unprecedented renters rights. We need a proven working class fighter like Kshama in Congress to go to war against the political establishment to fight for free healthcare for all funded by taxing the rich, national rent control, and an end to all military aid to Israel.
If you agree with these demands and you are in, or near, Seattle, join our campaign at our rally to elect Kshama on July 18th at 11am at Pratt Park. If we can get Kshama into the general election, that would be a massive leap forward for the antiwar movement, for the fight for universal public healthcare, and for working class fightback in the labor movement.
Our campaign is by far the most threatening one in decades to the Democratic and Republican parties, and the entire billionaire class which backs them. Kshama builds mass movements to disrupt business as usual, unlike the many self-described progressive candidates who have been elected only to be absorbed into the Democratic Party machine. We need an all-out fight against the both parties of Wall Street and war in order to wrest victories from the hands of the capitalist class. Join us to rally and help us get out the vote for Kshama so that we can get her into the general election and go head-to-head against genocidal Democrat, Adam Smith.
**Join our Get Out The Vote Rally for Kshama on July 18th at 11AM at Pratt Park.**
Solidarity,Kshama for Congress

We're hitting the road to speak with Texas voters about the threats data centers pose to our water and our health| | | |
---
| | | Peter, since I launched my campaign for Texas Lt. Governor last year, I've been speaking about how important it is to protect our most valuable natural resource - Water. Lately, this issue has been thrust into the headlines. We see how rampant commercial developments, such as data centers and crypto-mining operations, have been consuming vast amounts of water. Let me say it plainly: Our communities deserve real transparency and accountability from facilities that already exist or are under construction. **We must have a moratorium on new data center construction** until we can pass comprehensive legislation that puts the resource use of people and animals before the resource use of these massive facilities. On Tuesday, July 14th, I'm kicking off a tour to hear from people across the state. Starting with a press conference in Austin (which you can watch live online) and continuing with a tour of the South Plains region - currently on the front lines of data center development. name: Data Center Awareness
subject: Five Communities. One Warning.
body:
Across Pennsylvania, people are sounding the alarm about data centers. Josh Shapiro isn't listening.

| | | | | |
---
|
---
| | | | | | Hey Peter -
Over the past month, Stacy Garrity has traveled across Pennsylvania meeting with residents, township officials, county leaders, and community members concerned about massive data center developments coming to their neighborhoods.
She didn’t give a speech.
She went to listen.
And no matter where she went - From Wilkes-Barre to the Philadelphia suburbs to Cranberry Township - the concerns were strikingly similar.
Families are worried about soaring electricity demand.
Communities are worried about their water supply.
Residents are worried about industrial-scale facilities being built next to homes and farms.
Local officials are worried they’ll be left to deal with the consequences while decisions are made hundreds of miles away in Harrisburg.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | While Pennsylvanians have been raising these concerns, Josh Shapiro has been doing what he always does: changing his position whenever it’s politically convenient.
Just months ago, Shapiro was celebrating massive data center projects and touting Pennsylvania as a leader in attracting them.
Now, after public opposition has grown across the Commonwealth, he’s trying to rewrite history.
The people Stacy has met aren’t asking for politicians to score political points.
They’re asking to be heard.
They’re asking honest questions about what these massive developments could mean for their communities, their quality of life, and their future.
That’s exactly why Stacy has spend the past month meeting directly with people who will have to live with the consequences, not hiding behind press releases or changing her position when the political winds shift.
Take a few minutes to read about the conversations that happened across Pennsylvania:

A California company just got the green light to launch a [giant mirror into space](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu2zAMRb_G3hjIshqng4cu2V7XjgZtUTFfadGQmOfm7wunn9CN4ME9wL2_PqYPZOH8-IkbjZZ0ynRUITMqExfMs-jyGyMJ51jx9Si44jZ556_gBujCFJHlNYU2jonIU9_S2A234Hw_dNd2Hb8F7G-YFuz6GIc54YCIdP3e94FuGF3L42lzQxc65259uKR59l3AkHBOOA--CY4im5bLp3K2lZK89IvKZdGtlXE122vT_2j8vfH34zgudceFTtr4-_sG-rOLFjTWfP7QSISNauPvhZLQYqBlZkOBz2c1eKjBTmXjWlkzmILgMy8rsFXoqsE_7calaDnxOw1GuYImsFWfFXOssGkhWPQpEZKK6NGWMe4Hi3C9Dk1wjw1Z3k3sv-b_Gv3fAAAA___naqDE), aiming to bounce sunlight back to Earth after dark. The pitch is longer daylight for solar farms and work sites. Not everyone's thrilled about it, though, and we've got the story below. Are you frustrated with a phone battery that never seems to last the day? You are not alone, and the fix usually is not a trip to the store or a few hundred dollars for a new device. A handful of settings buried in your phone are quietly draining power all day long, and most of them are switched on by default without you ever knowing. In today's episode of _The Flyover Podcast_, Ayla walks through seven quick changes that can stretch your battery well past what you are getting now. ## US Reimposes Blockade, Sets Hormuz Toll
President Trump announced Monday the U.S. will reimpose its blockade of Iran's ports and [charge ships a 20% fee to pass](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAYBOCnwZst_JtCMjB08ZauHa0f-DG0YCJMYqVPX7mv0Pmk73T3eVtuGFPc1g_MpJsvy0bHnqg1qkusuJlU7Dc6SnFzO77WigHzAhxkz1U_isVhTK9FdE57IqCpIz2qi-AwqVF2Qb9xdbmClCQtKoIrGgDlSHLLpfcTdFGfGlejGDm_TGLwxsAoUHg0Ho0CJji52EodvkrcWiCfXuVJdbAld0mH1u47m94ZzAzm4zgGuxl7hgzmk2Ywc8VgHicGc6uPfO_PZX0oNT9--r1VjK23AetKfaWYzaPuNISWU1e1ux8xpbhLxQRfM8b019v-ddZTw28AAAD___1ffdo) safely through the Strait of Hormuz, which carries a fifth of the world's oil. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

subject: 16 Saturdays left
body:

# Only 16 Saturdays to Save Maryland.
---
| | Dear , We want to thank you for all you have and are doing to save Maryland with us. What we cannot do alone, you are helping happen together. **IMPORTANT - please read our PS below as well as this e-mail update.**

We as Republicans in Maryland are united like never before; Wes Moore has awakened us to the need of this hour. **Our children and seniors are questioning a future here in Maryland, businesses and family finances are facing certain overwhelming taxes and fee increases, and our streets are more and more dangerous, only to get worse without change**.

**We literally only have 16 Saturdays until the election on November 3** where we will determine the future of our State. This is why I am personally asking for your help now to do three things:

1\. Sponsor our TV ads now running state-wide on streaming services to over 550 channels such as ESPN, NBC/CBS/ABC, CNN, FoxNews, movie shows, and more. We also need to get our ads on cable. We need at least [10 donors at $400/week](https://us.list-manage.com/108xXCu659q?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) for the remaining 16 weeks until the election to cover this push. Will you help us?

2\. Sign up to volunteer to door knock with me and our teams across the five bluest counties plus Baltimore City. People are hurting and they realize it's not about Party politics, it is about right policies. When we reach them door to door, they vote for our policies. Sign up today [here](https://us.list-manage.com/Wet275HLmas?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).

3\. [Display a sign](https://us.list-manage.com/ze_4wSBkQ0z?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) and [buy our merch](https://us.list-manage.com/16uY4Nh9kPW?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b). We are adding new merchandise weekly - help us out by getting it delivered to your house and displaying them.
Thank you for joining us to fight for our State, Our Beautiful Maryland.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/ErSh3Ftq2GX?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
Dan Cox
Republican Nominee for Governor of Maryland
P.S. If you are wondering why I am asking you every day now for help to win, it is because this is the most time sensitive task we have: to raise the funds necessary to save our State and get our excellent TV ads all over streaming, cable and social media platforms reaching millions. Keep in mind it can take 5-7 days to get a TV ad airing once we have shot the commercial, just because of cyclical programming. So this request if acted on today by you will actually matriculate into TV ads likely a week from now at the earliest. So this is why time is of the essence today. Thank you for helping!

Authority: Dan Cox for Governor; Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer.

## Abbott Announces $5.5M Medical Training Grants
Gov. Greg Abbott announced [$5.5 million in grants](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypCAQRp8GM6aAwb-AYBOz2XRDq7UbpQrBAsYZ335Lg_sCN-9z6vT37zW-wHkXlr-wkSlfG8dAn-ypFEpjoS9kT4CU8hpDTN4FzHQuoxKq4aLlUo8Izp-jrtBMAntZkZFtp4VqetFXq1EWQdgZ20n0GlXfNR0Ki50kQXNtbeXMJROt1FIKqdtHK7HGqbdW1oJIN0wLQldiepSV7iTrz3hQesxxq7xZS9kze_5hamBqyBAgLOSjdwddF0wN10tMDTfL1PAT_2RqWOLBYZpiKRxCiO8wU-Z1zTfnvYuB03eHgHxPboN08hkS8ZLABRcWfhv5Ruhm8DyXN1IouUoG98_F56ZlWiwbOH_Hlt9NfBj1PwAA__8SxZPY) to give Texas medical students hands-on training with primary care doctors across the state. The three Statewide Preceptorship Program [grants will fund](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkTHSpCAQhU-DWU8BAyKBwSZm_6YbWq20ShWCC8w43n7LucLG3fW999X78zP-oA8-rr9xp75-ljRGOkugWimPlT5YAqGjXLYUUw4-ukLXOkouW-AGhBod-nCNqnH9xJ0VDfXCdIrL1nLbbL2dVYdcG9PqxXRaS9tR55SWtp2nxT0b398wboQSggtlHkY47Sa7LEJzItUyxcn5mvKjbvSttIQrvSk_5rQ3od9qPQp7_mJyYHI4z_NxLoj3kckBc_VzICaH24vJIaQZA5PDF8Tk8PeFwdcLjux3zBfMmAnmkApBTbClnWBNb8BpSrUCxphecaYCWu_gI6wZYy33a3kdR8oVdnJ-xgClvhzFemfIzoDWnaNFapDOWVC2nWCyzyeItjMdSj4JS03u3XH6EHxpDVN83dGHr2X9v23evfwXAAD__7XPo9o) training in family medicine, general internal medicine, and pediatrics, with an emphasis on preparing physicians for rural and medically underserved communities. "_Texas families deserve quality primary care close to home_ ," Abbott said. Students typically complete their preceptorships during the summer between their first and second years of medical school. The program, [administered by](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAURb8GOw2PQRkLim3sZtstDQ5PIEEh8DLM_P1m_YXtb-45OT-P9WFCDKf7Ngdqeu9pPbHViERYVsK3qRGNxVJ9OlOJ4bQVP24VXEw9Vz3I1ZoQP6vsrN64naFDDeouuZhmPndec7iDuo9mQ5g2RHXbnyPCDhZQGCl5F_TfGVcgAThINSiwo93mfYeRI8qJSY42UCoDebyU9vhJLyzDMx1d1J4oV3b7YmJhYmmtDT44jwXtcK0Hl15MLK6YkyoTSyVD2ILFPhd8YqZUqg-5zyW5Yo6-5szE0hVtcwsxhjopJrk7TIgXkf7X6aXFbwAAAP__6QR_eQ) the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board, dates to 1978.
## DPS Hunts Police Impersonator on U.S. 190
The Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) is searching for a man who [posed as a police officer](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDFywyAQRU-DOjSAkTAFRRo6p02pQWKxmCAtA9iyb5-Rr5B-5-377-c23VxMcb9_uw1MewWcdjhqgtagTA1eriZwHkpdcceS4u4rvO-TYGKkTFEuJ-9iek-y82ZmXvMODFdXycSome5WE9jgVNAO5iv4xc3KDdrNnocF_MAG3UVzwpjiknPGpeoV94OfdQh8YAByJJKBjw1L31b4KIX0xieUfsGtS2ZtLVdy-SLCEmGP4-iXFJdfseKjNtzPKyLsOYsIm3BxiQh7_iTCMkWE5Rci7AdMfa40F5yh0gIZS6sUA82Y4gI0bhlKxd01LDQ_0tmNniLUl_iEUinu9FEp14wI2xXj8xFTinVURLL75mL6KLf_hX4a8RcAAP__pkiVGw) and pulled over drivers on U.S. 190 north of Houston. The suspect conducted traffic stops in Walker, San Jacinto, and Polk counties while driving an unmarked black [2022 Jeep Gladiator](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSpCAURb8GM7p4iDIEBJuYzaYbWk95tOwgWMCO7d9vtb8w0Q1u1b2nzp_P-RNDDOn5G3ey7eXznOiskVqjMjd6YY2EjkrdcsolhuQqXc9ZCjlyoTmo2WGI16w6ZxfhDHRkQX8oIUcjTLdZpTUKtwDCMEiPA314b8Cv5PpVgtJdsO8xoUEBCFD6ocENbjHewyCI1MiUIBdaLo-20Y3k45W_qTzWvHfRbq0dlfW_mJyYnHBZoX83TE5Hru2OGFbiYT-o1Jyw5cJPTI0cPzF-UeEVE_-La0gt8yPHL77mf6kFqvz-4-6ovOJVmZzAKGM09ExOXbHuOEOMoY6aKfHcMcQbqv1M5beV_wMAAP__c86KRQ), DPS said. Investigators suspect that multiple drivers may have been stopped by the man, who wore civilian clothing. They're [asking victims to come forward](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSrCAURL8GMyzgIWhA8BKz2XRDC-Wq1CLXgrvjzN9vzdT-webdp0735226-Zhi3j78AY4eK04ZrpqACMpE8PA1gQ9Q6o4ZS4o5VHhukxLKcGG51FPwMT0n3QQ3izDIBpy0vRbKDGJodjfLIJX2vbVm6a0yRst-Xny3is52nV-a6F4wYaWWUkhtWytDF-ZhXWUnALRhWkCIhKWlHd5Ka3riHUq74NEktxOdlf37z9TI1HhdV7viQ5kdvythfoWYGl-rmBrfdR7OyivAV-X3uFA8KvcpwQaBn5jiAjweJ5SK2RMWnrHQzn9xTXHhvGJKsRrLtNgOH9NbhP52392pnwAAAP__cOyIIQ).
## Texas Leaders Honor Sen. Lindsey Graham
